items.text: All nine workshop decisions are resolved and incorporated into plan.md. Round 1: D1=A (7-day TTL from run end with auto-deny + teardown, env var WORKSPACE_SANDBOX_MANUAL_REVIEW_TTL), D2=A (greenfield wholesale replacement of the legacy field surface), D3=B (parallel with execute/gct-pending-ai-provenance-hardening via shared schema-version contract), D4=A (single shared applyAtRunEnd call site at end of Execute()), D5=A (7→4 RunOutcome mapping table). Round 2: D6=A (new POST /api/v1/sandboxes/{id}/apply-at-run-end endpoint + Provider.ApplyAtRunEnd method), D7=A (new Run.ConversationID; child runs inherit from ParentRunID's run, else fresh UUID), D8=A (typed Source enum on requests + audit events), D9=A (ManualReviewTTL on LifecycleConfig consumed by existing LifecycleReconciler).

Synthesis tightening during finalize: the typed Source enum (D8) was extended to include the system-initiated workspace-sandbox-gc value so the audit-event source field stays truly typed when the GC auto-deny path (Phase 4 step 14c) emits a transition. The enum is now ∈ {agent-manager-auto-apply, git-control-tower, agent-manager-ui, workspace-sandbox-ui, cli, workspace-sandbox-gc}; inbound ApprovalRequest / ApplyAtRunEndRequest carrying workspace-sandbox-gc are rejected at decode. This resolves a contradiction where Phase 4 step 14c emitted a value that wasn't enumerated by Phase 2 step 7. Test #13 was extended to cover the new rejection rule.

All five readiness dimensions reach 3. problem_clarity=3 (locked contract + enumerated deltas), scope_defined=3 (acceptance_allow set; acceptance_deny intentionally empty with rationale; planned changes align with globs), approach_solid=3 (seven phases, concrete file:line targets, all 9 decisions resolved), testable=3 (13 test cases enumerated with file paths, layers, and clock-injection strategy for the GC TTL test), risk_awareness=3 (matrix covers schema-coordination slip, in-flight runs at deploy, GC false-positive, lossy RunOutcome mapping, apply-on-failure exposure, route-divergence drift).

Cross-initiative implications surfaced for the orchestrator: (1) gct-pending-ai-provenance-hardening (initiative git-control-tower-ai-provenance, upstream) ships the schema reader side; per D3 the two items run in parallel against a shared typed schema-version contract, and the operator-visible feature gates on both merging. (2) sandbox-runtime-e2e-verification (downstream sibling) cannot start its multi-surface validation until this item lands. (3) agent-manager-default-sandboxing-rollout (downstream sibling) flips spawn-surface defaults; nothing in this item changes the default RunMode. (4) Per D7, spawn surfaces (web-console, swarm-manager queue, cron, CLI) should be flagged to populate Run.ConversationID where they already know they are continuing an agent thread; the inheritance-from-ParentRunID + UUID-fallback covers the gap until each spawner is updated, so this is a quality-of-life follow-up rather than a blocker.

No remaining gaps require another normal workshop round. The plan is ready for execution. The orchestrator may queue this item; sequencing reminder: gct-pending-ai-provenance-hardening must merge before the operator-visible AI Changes UI flips, but this item itself can land in parallel against the shared schema-version contract per D3.

plan_updates: Finalize pass: incorporated D6–D9 fully and tightened the typed Source enum (D8) to include workspace-sandbox-gc as a system-initiated-only value, resolving the Phase 2 step 7 ↔ Phase 4 step 14c contradiction. Updated five locations: scope (in scope), target end state #3, Phase 2 step 7 (with the inbound-rejection rule), Phase 4 step 14c (removed the contradictory parenthetical), Definition of Done #2, contract decisions table D8, and testing plan #13 (extended to cover inbound rejection). No new questions raised; all five readiness dimensions reach 3.
